texts: G.P.Pharmacy College
Empowering Pharmacists, Enhancing Lives

Our Chairman Er.G.Ponnusamy,B.E., educationist is providing basic education to all middle class and poor peoples. He started ITI in 1979, then he started Tirupattur Arts and science College, GP Polytechnic, GP College of education and GP Pharmacy College.
GP Pharmacy college is the first Pharmacy college in Tirupattur as well as Vellore District too.It is started in 2019 with all the infrastructures required as per norms of AICTE,New Delhi, and Pharmacy Council of India , New Delhi.
